scope: 2010; Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, DC, Florida
cross_check: Compared age 15-44 sum (all birth-order categories) with existing NCHS total ASFR panel; differences ranged from -0.7% to -3.3% across the ten states.
interpretation: Suitable for parser/key smoke testing; not sufficient for statewide calibration until all 48 batches and a documented numerator reconciliation are complete.
